headline: OPEN

fields.relation: K_aff is a purely transcendental extension of K_proj of degree one
fields.bridge: properness gives C_gen(K_aff) nonempty iff C_gen(K_proj) nonempty

proved: every genuine Klein twist and every scalar extension of it has index one
therefore no valuation can force local index divisible by three or local degree subgroup 3Z
the ordinary relative Brauer group of a smooth genuine Klein twist is zero
a pure Newton-polytope nonintersection is unavailable for the non-monomial cubic hypersurface
every discrete rank-one coefficient valuation of the exact cubic has an integral tropical projective value vector
five absolutely prime divisorial valuations of K_aff have exact simple residue points and hence completed-field points
the degree-five invariant is the Hessian determinant up to 32, and the canonical Hessian-kernel line has no generic rational intersection point with the Klein cubic
not_proved: a rational point over K_aff or K_proj
a pointless completion of the genuine twist
an exhaustive theorem for all divisorial or higher-rank valuations
a residue-field point or nonpoint theorem for the whole genuine f5 special cubic

smallest_remaining_terminal_theorem.valuation: the affine generic-field divisor f5=0 (or another certified prime invariant boundary)
smallest_remaining_terminal_theorem.model: the proper integral genuine Hilbert-90 cubic after proving one common smooth open
smallest_remaining_terminal_theorem.decision: prove its residue cubic over C(f5=0)^G has no rational point, or construct a point away from the now-excluded canonical Hessian-kernel line
smallest_remaining_terminal_theorem.negative_payoff: smooth proper reduction plus residue pointlessness gives a pointless completion and hence generic pointlessness
smallest_remaining_terminal_theorem.required_boundary: the residue cubic still has index one, so component-multiplicity, degree-subgroup, and ordinary Brauer shortcuts cannot prove the nonpoint
